## 0.2.240

owes: none — the hub tolerates `HUB_URL`, `AUTOSTART` and `SETUP_DONE` in `synchub.conf` (the keys `:desktop` writes there), so an entry-tier install that wrote them boots instead of refusing on an unknown key; any other unknown file key and every unknown `SYNCHUB_*` variable still refuse; no migration, rollback safe.

owes: none — *Where I left off* is a fourth startup view (`lastView`, FeedScraper's own `LAST_VIEW`), the hub remembers each person's last reader list in the new local `feed.local_web` collection (never on the wire), and bare `GET /` now answers `303` to the startup view instead of `301 /feeds`; no migration, no wire or CSP change, rollback safe — a browser that cached the old `301` for `/` may keep going to `/feeds` until its cache drops it.
